seo.title: Pro bono engineering simulation
seo.description: WAHHF Foundation offers free engineering simulations (structures, fluids, heat, design advice) to small organisations in Cameroon, and trains young engineers on real cases.

hero.titre: Free engineering simulation for businesses and projects in Cameroon
hero.intro: Our engineers and supervised young talent check, simulate and advise, free of charge, the small organisations that build the local economy.

carte.alt: Drawing: the frame of a farm barn, two columns and a roof truss, under the push of the wind and the weight of the roof. It bends gently, and the most stressed members light up in yellow.

pourquoi.titre: A double impact: the local economy and young people.

economie.texte: Small businesses, craftspeople and youth start-ups: a part or a structure checked before it is built means less wasted material and fewer risks.

jeunesse.texte: Young engineers and students, under supervision, learn on real cases: those of the organisations that need them.

iroko.texte: The foundation is the social branch of the IROKO Group, which covers its running costs.

publics.titre: For organisations that cannot afford a study.
publics.nonTexte: For these needs, IROKO Engineer, the engineering division of the IROKO Group, carries out complete studies.

exemples.intro: Examples to give you an idea: these are not completed projects.

etapes.titre: Five steps, from your need to the report.

engagements.titre: What we promise, and what we do not do.

jeunes.surtitre: Young people at the heart of the programme
jeunes.titre: Students and young engineers learning on real cases.
jeunes.texte: Supervised by engineers, students and young engineers take part in the studies. They train on real needs: those of the organisations that keep the local economy going.

soumettre.intro: Describe your need and attach your plans or photos if you have any. We will get back to you once we have studied your request.
soumettre.irokoTitre: Need a complete or certified study?

prediagnostic.texte: A conversation to understand your need.
prediagnostic.recu: You receive a clear opinion on what a simulation can do for you.

etude.texte: A targeted calculation on the question that matters to you.
etude.recu: You receive a simplified report, with its conclusions.

conseil.recu: You receive practical recommendations for your part or your structure.

atelier.texte: For your teams, your pupils or your students.
atelier.recu: You receive a session to discover engineering simulation.

certifiees.texte: Studies that must be certified or signed by a chartered engineer

hangar.titre: Roof frame of a farm barn
hangar.besoin: Check that a steel or timber roof frame withstands the wind and the weight of the roof.

chassis.besoin: An oil press or a cassava grinder: check the frame that takes the loads and the vibrations.

sechoir.besoin: Move warm air evenly, to dry produce without damaging it.

classe.besoin: Cool a room without air conditioning, by placing the openings better.

reservoir.besoin: Check the support of a full tank, under its own weight and under the wind.

besoin.texte: With the form on this page: your project, and your plans or photos if you have any.

eligibilite.texte: We check that your project fits the programme and that a simulation can help you.

cadrage.texte: By video call, phone or WhatsApp, to clarify the question and the data.

simulation.texte: We model your part or your structure, then run the calculation.

restitution.texte: A simplified report, and a conversation to explain the results and the possible next steps.

structures.texte: Find out whether a part or a structure holds, and where it works hardest.

fluides.texte: Understand how air, water or heat flows.

conception.texte: Choose the best shape before building.

gratuit.texte: No payment, at any step. If anyone asks you for money for this programme, do not pay and let us know.

confidentialite.texte: Your plans are used only for your study. A non-disclosure agreement can be signed before you send them.

fichiers.texte: Your plans, models and data belong to you, before and after the study.

selection.texte: Projects are chosen according to their local usefulness.

limite.texte: Our results are indicative and educational. They do not replace a certified calculation report: for a structure or a piece of equipment, have them validated by a chartered engineer.

gratuit.question: Is it really free?
gratuit.reponse: Yes. You pay nothing, at any step. The foundation is the social branch of the IROKO Group, which covers its running costs.

qui.question: Who carries out the simulations?
qui.reponse: Our engineers, with young engineers and students they supervise.

beneficiaires.question: Who can benefit?
beneficiaires.reponse: Small organisations based in Cameroon: micro, small and medium-sized businesses, craftspeople, start-ups and young people’s projects, schools and universities, associations and local authorities.

fichiers.question: Which files should I send?
fichiers.reponse: Whatever you have: plans, sketches, photos or CAD files (PDF, JPG, PNG, STEP, IGES, DWG, DXF, or a ZIP), 10 MB in total. A precise description is enough to start.

confidentialite.question: Do my plans remain confidential?
confidentialite.reponse: Yes. They are used only for your study. You can ask for a non-disclosure agreement before sending them: tick the box in the form.

delai.question: How long does it take?
delai.reponse: It depends on the project and on the number of requests in progress. You are told the timeframe after the scoping conversation.

certifies.question: Are the results certified?
certifies.reponse: No. They are indicative and educational, and do not replace a certified calculation report. For a structure or a piece of equipment, have them validated by a chartered engineer, or contact IROKO Engineer.

refus.question: What if my project is not selected?
refus.reponse: We tell you, with a lead whenever possible: a resource, a training course, or IROKO Engineer for a complete study.
